headline: Leeds closes streets so children can play outside safely
summary: Play Streets are being rolled out in poorer areas, giving kids a rare chance to play together away from traffic.
script: A city in England is closing residential streets so children can play outside safely. The Play Streets scheme in Leeds gives kids a rare chance to play together away from traffic, and is being expanded into poorer neighbourhoods.
imageAlt: Children play on scooters in a residential street closed to traffic in Leeds.
imageAltTwo: Children make bubbles together on the closed street, watched by a parent in a high-vis vest.

sources.title: Leeds: The city closing down streets so children can play
